CASE STUDIES

Evidence should explain what actually changed.

A useful case study connects the original business problem to the work performed and the result that can be supported. Client permission and reliable evidence come before publication.

PUBLICATION STATUS

No verified case studies are published yet.

We are keeping the library empty until results can be supported and the client has approved publication. Illustrative process diagrams elsewhere on the site are not case-study evidence.

A future case study should show the decisions, the work and the limits of what the available data can establish.

What we will document

Situation and diagnosis
The original business problem, starting conditions and why a particular approach was chosen.
Work and timeframe
What Markevance actually did, the client’s contribution and the period the work covers.
Evidence and definitions
The source of each result, the baseline where available and a clear definition of the metric.
Permission and limitations
Approval to identify the client or use their material, plus attribution limits and lessons.
